main.summary: Runs the command and binds binary CliWrap output and error streams to callbacks.

field.name: observer
field.summary: Binary Command Observer used to receive notifications and data.

field.name: buffered
field.summary: Indicates whether RunAsync will return a with binary output buffers.

field.name: StdOutRelay
field.summary: Relay that delivers stdout to its observer callback and optionally captures bytes for a buffered result.

field.name: StdErrRelay
field.summary: Relay that delivers stderr to its observer callback and optionally captures bytes for a buffered result.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Initializes a new BinaryCommandRunner with the specified observer and buffering behavior.
constructor.param: True to return a with binary output; false to stream output to the observer.

method.name: CreateStdOutTarget
method.summary: Creates a PipeTarget that drains standard output into the stdout relay.
method.returns: PipeTarget that writes stdout into the pipe.

method.name: CreateStdErrTarget
method.summary: Creates a PipeTarget that drains standard error into the stderr relay.
method.returns: PipeTarget that writes stderr into the pipe.

method.name: RunAsync
method.summary: Runs the specified CliWrap command, wiring its output and error streams into the observer and returning the final result.
method.remarks: Starts both observer callbacks before command execution. Each relay drains its process stream independently, and buffered mode captures output while the command is running. If process startup fails, both observer streams complete empty and the launch error is propagated; the exit callback is reserved for a process that started.
method.param: Forceful cancellation token for the command.
Graceful cancellation token for the command.
method.returns: Task that produces a when the command and observer processing have completed.
method.exception: The forceful or graceful cancellation token cancels command execution.

method.name: ObserveAndDrainAsync
method.summary: Invokes an observer callback on its live stream and drains any bytes the callback leaves unread.
method.param: Observer callback for the stream and execution cancellation token.
Forceful command cancellation token passed to the callback.
method.returns: A task that completes after the callback and remaining stream data have completed, returning any callback or drain failure.

method.name: IsExpectedCancellation
method.summary: Determine whether an operation-canceled exception was caused by the supplied cancellation token.
method.returns: True only when the supplied token has been canceled and the exception carries that same token.

method.name: CreateBufferedResult
method.summary: Creates a from the captured stdout and stderr bytes.
method.param: Base process command result to augment with binary output.
method.returns: A result containing the process metadata and complete captured output.
